Raat Bhar Fatima Ke Rone Ki Gonjti Hai Sada Madine Mein
Jane Kis Din Bichaye Ga Mehdi Aa Ke Farsh-e-Azza Madine Mein

1
Hath Pehlu Pe Kis Liye Aaya Neel Kaisa Hai Tere Chehre Par
Kya Bataye Gi Ja Ke Baba Ko Zulm Kaise Howa Madine Mein

2
Jalta Darwaza Bhi Hatati Thi Haye Zahra Ke Bain Karti Thi
Aik Fizza Thi Bint-e-Sarwar Ka Jis Ne Matam Kiya Madine Mein

3
Ja Ke Baba Ki Qabar Par Bibi Jane Kis Dil Se Roz Kehti Thi
Ro Nahi Sakti Aap Ko Baba Aap Ki Fatima Madine Mein

4
Tere Akbar Ki Ya Imam-e-Zamaan Aik Hasrat Hai Pori Ho Jaye
Naam-e-Zahra Pe Ho Adda Mula Pursa Zanjeer Ka Madine Mein

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/raat-bhar-fatima-ke-rone-ki-goonjti-hai-sada-madine-mein-nw-b42cd4d8987a.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, metadata, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
assert old.casefold() == roman.casefold()
blocks = body.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(blocks) == 5 and len(blocks[0].splitlines()) == 2
for digit, block in zip('۱۲۳۴', blocks[1:]):
    number, *verses = block.splitlines()
    assert number == digit and len(verses) == 2
assert body.count('\\u200c') == body.count('بی\\u200cبی') == 1
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Roman wording and Urdu stanza structure verified.')
PY"
